column1: Mix the peanut butter, confectioners' sugar and softened margarine until thoroughly combined.
Roll into small balls and refrigerate another 30 minutes until firm.
Melt the chocolate chips with the paraffin in a double boiler.
Spear each ball with a toothpick and dip into the chocolate, leaving a small circle of peanut butter uncovered at the top so it looks like a buckeye.
Set on wax paper and refrigerate until the chocolate hardens.
